nodes.name: ABVX-OS

nodes.summary: Drop-in ASCII theme layer for any site. Vanilla, React, Vue and Web Components with four themes, toggles and terminal widgets.

nodes.name: azurmenton
nodes.summary: Multilingual direct-booking platform for three Menton beachfront/beachside apartments, with localized stay guides, Riviera events, weather, map-based trip planning, and a secure booking request flow (EN/FR/IT/UK)

nodes.name: book-landings
nodes.summary: Five independently deployed book and editorial landing sites in one tested Next.js monorepo.

nodes.name: CoqPi
nodes.summary: Private multilingual desktop copilot for live calls, interview practice, meeting transcription, and reviewed follow-up.

nodes.name: CortexABV-private

nodes.name: cropto
nodes.summary: Maintained agricultural commodity infrastructure prototype for indexed market data, document verification, and settlement workflows.

nodes.name: decision-map
nodes.summary: Installable Agent Skill and open protocol for mapping complex business, product, and go-to-market decisions into testable options and cascade logs.

nodes.name: git-tweet
nodes.summary: Self-hosted GitHub release announcements for X and Bluesky, with deduplication, logs, and retries.

nodes.name: ID

nodes.name: lab.abvx

nodes.name: liqua
nodes.summary: Multi-brand Next.js platform for commodity-market products, with Liqua as the live execution-layer reference.

nodes.name: index
nodes.summary: Multi-tenant commodity benchmarks and market intelligence for 1d3x, UGA Index, and SPIKE SPOT INDEX.

nodes.name: mn7r
nodes.summary: Private AI-assisted brokerage operating workspace for agro-commodity teams managing deals, clients, EXE workflows, governance, and market context.

nodes.name: pictiq
nodes.summary: Pictiq: an open visual-language protocol with canonical SVG symbols, compositional grammar, context packs, and entity-symbol support.

nodes.name: Pocket-OS-Cardputer-ABV
nodes.summary: Offline-first Pocket OS for M5Stack Cardputer ADV: music, books, voice notes, journeys, and a Mac companion.

nodes.name: SET
nodes.summary: Review-first GitHub Action and CLI for composing AI-ready repository workflows and exporting inspectable plans.

nodes.name: abvx-shortener
nodes.summary: Self-hosted short links on your own domain with Cloudflare Workers, an API, CLI, and Chrome extension.

nodes.name: abvx-agent-skills
nodes.summary: Reviewable capability layer for coding agents: portable skills, workflow patterns, verification gates, token-efficient execution, and bounded agent loops.

nodes.name: toki-pona-translator
nodes.summary: Toki Pona toolkit: AI translator, sitelen emoji mapping, multilingual display layer, and manuscript QA skill.

nodes.name: TS
nodes.summary: Bilingual (EN/BG) marketing site for Trade Solutions with live FX + futures strip, interactive markets map, and dark/light themes

nodes.name: YTMamp
nodes.summary: Retro desktop remote for YouTube Music with a Chromium companion, waveform, media controls, and local integration API.
